<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/account.ts -->
<!--
  A sign-in, sign-up or password reset card: heading, one sentence, the fields of the mode, a submit button,
  optional alternative sign-in buttons and a link to the other mode. Axes: mode (signin, signup, reset), layout
  (card, plain), social (none, show).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { AuthLabels } from "./auth-card.types";

export type AuthCardProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  submit: string;
  switchText: string;
  switchLink: string;
  switchHref?: string;
  labels: AuthLabels;
  mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  social?: "none" | "show" | "first";
  level?: 1 | 2;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Separator from "../primitives/separator/separator.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import AuthForm from "../components/auth-form.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  submit,
  switchText,
  switchLink,
  switchHref,
  labels,
  mode = "signin",
  layout = "card",
  social = "none",
  level = 2,
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<AuthCardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="cn(
      'flex w-full flex-col gap-6',
      (((layout as string) === 'card') ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')
    )"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl('{0}-title', id))"
    data-testid="auth-card"
    :data-mode="mode"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Stack gap="2">
      <Title :as="level" size="2xl" weight="bold" :id="tpl('{0}-title', id)">
        {{ title }}
      </Title>
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ text }}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
    <Stack
      v-if="(((social as string) === 'first') && ((social as string) !== 'none') && ((mode as string) !== 'reset') && ((mode as string) !== 'magic'))"
      gap="4"
      data-testid="social"
    >
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.divider }}
        </Text>
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
      </Group>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="key-round" :size="16" />
        {{ labels.passkey }}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="mail" :size="16" />
        {{ labels.magic }}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
    <AuthForm :id="id" :mode="mode" :labels="labels" :submit="submit" />
    <Stack
      v-if="(((social as string) !== 'first') && ((social as string) !== 'none') && ((mode as string) !== 'reset') && ((mode as string) !== 'magic'))"
      gap="4"
      data-testid="social"
    >
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.divider }}
        </Text>
        <Separator class="flex-1" />
      </Group>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="key-round" :size="16" />
        {{ labels.passkey }}
      </Button>
      <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button" class="w-full">
        <LucideIcon name="mail" :size="16" />
        {{ labels.magic }}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
    <Text size="sm" class="text-center text-muted-foreground">
      {{ switchText }}
      {{ " " }}
      <Link :href="switchHref" variant="default" data-testid="switch">
        {{ switchLink }}
      </Link>
    </Text>
  </Block>
</template>
